name: CAISO — hourly utility-scale solar & wind generation, system load, DA price, weather & calendar — CAISO utility-scale hourly solar PV generation (output) (covariate forecasting bundle)
citation: CAISO (http://oasis.caiso.com/oasisapi/SingleZip?queryname=SLD_REN_FCST&market_run_id=ACTUAL&version=1); Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive); python stdlib zoneinfo (n/a)
license: CAISO OASIS: public postings (attribution). Open-Meteo: CC-BY 4.0 (non-commercial free tier).
description: CAISO utility-scale hourly solar PV generation (output). This bundle forecasts `caiso_solar_generation` from a covariate panel of global_horizontal_irradiance, air_temperature, cloud_cover, wind_speed, hour_of_day, day_of_week, caiso_wind_generation, caiso_system_load, sp15_day_ahead_lmp. Source dataset 'CAISO — hourly utility-scale solar & wind generation, system load, DA price, weather & calendar' — hourly cadence, 26245 rows, 2023-07-01T07:00:00Z..2026-07-01T06:00:00Z (ISO-8601 UTC). NON-EIA (the forecasting model is trained on EIA data, so EIA inputs are excluded): NONE of these are EIA. solar_gen_mw is REAL metered/actual solar generation published by CAISO (the California grid operator) via its OASIS SLD_REN_FCST ACTUAL report — it is a legitimate utility-scale PV output series, NOT a physics proxy and NOT fabricated. Wind, load and price are likewise CAISO OASIS actuals/day-ahead postings. Open-Meteo weather is ERA5 reanalysis from ECMWF/Copernicus. No series is sourced from or derived from eia.gov.
preprocessing: 1. Loop over three monthly windows (2026-04, 2026-05, 2026-06; CAISO caps a SingleZip call at ~31 days). startdatetime/enddatetime pinned to 07:00 UTC = 00:00 PDT so windows tile cleanly.

2. For each window GET CAISO OASIS SingleZip queryname=SLD_REN_FCST&market_run_id=ACTUAL, follow the 302 redirect, save the ZIP under datasets/raw/, and parse the XML REPORT_DATA rows (with sleeps + retries for throttling).

3. Convert INTERVAL_START_GMT (UTC) to naive America/Los_Angeles local hours. Sum RENEW_FCST_ACT_MW across the three trading hubs (NP15,SP15,ZP26) per hour: RENEWABLE_TYPE=Solar -> solar_gen_mw, Wind -> wind_gen_mw.
4. Clip generation lower bound to 0 (small nightly auxiliary-load negatives, ~-50 MW vs ~19 GW peak, are not physical PV/wind output).
5. GET SLD_FCST&market_run_id=ACTUAL per window; keep RESOURCE_NAME=='CA ISO-TAC' (CAISO system total) -> load_mw (hourly).
6. GET PRC_LMP&market_run_id=DAM&node=TH_SP15_GEN-APND per window; keep DATA_ITEM=='LMP_PRC' (total LMP) -> price (hourly day-ahead).

7. Pull Open-Meteo ERA5 hourly weather (shortwave_radiation=GHI, temperature_2m, cloud_cover, wind_speed_10m) for the CAISO solar-fleet point (Kern County 35.29,-119.01) with timezone=America/Los_Angeles so its naive-local hours align 1:1 with CAISO.
8. Inner-join solar + wind + load + price + weather on the hourly local timestamp (keeps only fully-observed hours).
9. Add known-future calendar covariates hour, dow. Reorder columns to ts, target, grid covariates, weather covariates, calendar.
10. Time-interpolate residual gaps up to 3h; drop any remaining NaN rows. Write wide CSV sorted by ts.

11. EXTENDED 2026-07: history pulled back to 2023-07-01 (3 years) from the same NON-EIA grid-operator + Open-Meteo sources; series rebuilt on a UTC hourly index (DST-safe); timestamps emitted as ISO-8601 UTC.
12. Dropped calendar/time-derived variables (hour_of_day, day_of_week) so the only notion of time retained is the shared timestamps list.

13. Renamed all variable names and units from snake_case codes to plain English (CSV row/column structure unchanged). Name and unit mapping — caiso_solar_generation [MW] -> "CAISO solar generation" [megawatts] (target; CAISO actual utility-scale solar PV generation); global_horizontal_irradiance [W/m²] -> "global horizontal irradiance" [watts per square meter] (covariate; downward shortwave solar radiation (GHI)); air_temperature [°C] -> "air temperature" [degrees Celsius] (covariate; 2 m air temperature); cloud_cover [%] -> "cloud cover" [percent] (covariate; total cloud cover); wind_speed [km/h] -> "wind speed" [kilometers per hour] (covariate; 10 m wind speed); caiso_wind_generation [MW] -> "CAISO wind generation" [megawatts] (covariate; CAISO actual utility-scale wind generation); caiso_system_load [MW] -> "CAISO system load" [megawatts] (covariate; CAISO system actual demand (CA ISO-TAC)); sp15_day_ahead_lmp [$/MWh] -> "SP15 day-ahead locational marginal price" [US dollars per megawatt-hour] (covariate; SP15 hub day-ahead Locational Marginal Price).
